definitions.explanation: Japan's largest chain of 100-yen shops, selling household goods, stationery, kitchenware and snacks mostly at 100 yen plus tax; it also has many shops abroad.

examples.japanese: ダイソー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、ダイソー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧や⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦{用品|ようひん}→用品：13526_youhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そろえた。
examples.english: I've just moved, so I got my dishes and cleaning supplies together at Daiso.

notes:
A 100-yen shop is called {百円|ひゃくえん}⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧, or {百均|ひゃっきん} for short. Not every item is 100 yen: some are 300 or 500.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ダイソー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at Daiso
- ダイソー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: Daiso goods
